scope: Synthetic in-memory Swift normalization and JSONL parse-plus-normalize only. Parser suites pass every row to CodexJSONLParser; the app also filters log lines before parsing. Each sample warms up once in-process; startup is outside the timed interval. Peak RSS covers the entire benchmark process. These figures do not measure the desktop app.
